text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Takarazuka Kinen. Before the race, Mejiro Palmer and Daitaku Helios bring as much hype as they can in the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Grandmother Mejiro absent from the crowd and her bestie beside her, Mejiro Palmer can be herself. With that firmly in mind, she heads into the race.
